reason: I can throw together a Playwright script that walks the sitemap and dumps full-page shots at a few viewports in an afternoon, and I already have something like it. Nine bucks a month isn't much, but I'm not paying for something I can run myself for free.
objection: The change alerts are the only bit I can't knock out quickly, and in my experience those tools flag every cookie banner, carousel and lazy-loaded image as a change, so I'd end up ignoring the emails. Plus it's brand new with no reviews, and I'd be pasting client session cookies into it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing on one of my own client sites that the change detection ignores dynamic noise and only flags real layout or content changes, with a free trial of the scheduling so I can check that first.
